scenario: [LSTR.3.2] A non-ASCII codepoint orders by its value. "é" is U+00E9, above "z" (U+007A); "y" is below. Against `i.label > "z"` only "é" fires. A locale collation sorts "é" with "e", before "z", and logs nothing; a signed-char byte comparison reads 0xC3 as negative and logs nothing either.
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    label: String mutable

rule hit:
    Item i where i.label > "z"
->
    log info "{i.label}"
